summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py, which returns a new Graph with the Concise Bounded Description of a resource (triples with the resource as subject, recursing into blank-node objects with a guard against cycles). Added testCBD and testCBDBlankNodeCycle to test/test_graph.py (plus BNode and Literal imports), and a "Concise Bounded Description" section with an example in docs/utilities.rst. Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions. CHANGELOG.md and requirements.txt (black) were left unchanged, and nothing was committed.
